steps.title: The same card, from Babel's output
steps.titleZh: 同一张卡片，来自 Babel 的产物
steps.text: This page imports `Card` and `Button` from `dist/babel/index.js`, the files Babel wrote, instead of from `src/`. It shows the same card, with a **Babel package loaded** button. That button has no `onClick`, so clicking it does nothing.
steps.textZh: 这个页面从 `dist/babel/index.js`，也就是 Babel 写出的文件，导入 `Card` 和 `Button`，而不是从 `src/` 导入。它显示同样的卡片，里面是一个 **Babel 包已加载**按钮。这个按钮没有 `onClick`，所以点了也没有反应。

steps.title: The CSS import survived
steps.text: Babel rewrites files one by one but does not bundle them, so its `Card.js` still imports `card.css`. That only works through a tool that understands CSS imports. Vite built this page and turned the import into a stylesheet, so the card has its border and its rounded corners. The values below come from `card.css`.
steps.textZh: Babel 逐个改写文件，但不做打包，所以它输出的 `Card.js` 仍然导入 `card.css`。这只有交给能处理 CSS 导入的工具才行得通。这个页面由 Vite 构建，它把这行导入变成了样式表，所以卡片有边框，也有圆角。下面的值都来自 `card.css`。

steps.title: Read what Babel wrote
steps.titleZh: 看看 Babel 写了什么
steps.text: This step fetches `dist/babel/Card.js` and prints it below. Compare it with `src/Card.jsx`: the JSX became a call to `_jsx` from `react/jsx-runtime`, and `import './card.css'` is still there. `build.mjs` copies `card.css` next to the output, so that import finds its file.
steps.textZh: 这一步取回 `dist/babel/Card.js`，打印在下面。和 `src/Card.jsx` 对照一下：JSX 变成了对 `react/jsx-runtime` 里 `_jsx` 的调用，`import './card.css'` 则原样保留。`build.mjs` 会把 `card.css` 复制到产物旁边，这行导入才能找到文件。
